$comment: Replies are sent with Telegram's HTML parse mode. Each message is a list of lines joined with newlines. Supported tags: <b>, <i>, <u>, <s>, <code>, <pre>, <a href>, <blockquote>, <tg-spoiler>. Escape literal <, > and & as < > &. Telegram has no list markup, so bullets are plain '•' characters.
